newsitem.title: USA: Barnett Banks to acquire Oxford Resources.
newsitem.headline: Barnett Banks to acquire Oxford Resources.

text.p: Barnett Banks Inc said Tuesday that it reached a definitive agreement to acquire Oxford Resources Corp in a deal valued at $570 million, based on the closing price of Barnett shares Monday.
Under the terms of the agreement, Oxford shareholders will receive 0.9085 shares of Barnett common stock for each share of Oxford common stock in a tax-free exchange.
Barnett expects the transaction to be neutral to slightly accretive to earnings in the first year and increasingly accretive thereafter.

Barnett said its board of directors has authorized the repurchase of up 15 million shares of Barnett's common stock, in addition to the 20 million shares authorized to be repurched in 1995. The company has bought back around 15 million shares from the original authorization.

Oxford, based in Melville, N.Y., provides leases and loans for new and used automobiles through more than 2,000 auto dealers in 21 states across the country and had total lease and loan originations in 1996 of about $1 billion.

Barnett, which originates about 25 percent of all automobile loans in Florida, said the agreement ensures that Oxford's management will remain in place. It said it expects the transaction to close by mid-year 1997.
